scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "uv run --project apps/api uvicorn lineage_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.reset: uv run --project apps/api python -m lineage_api.cli reset
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web && npm run test:infra
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace infra
scripts.test:aws:ephemeral: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev --extra aws pytest -q tests/aws/test_ephemeral_workflow.py
